entries.name: SN76496 PSG
entries.description: Programmable sound generator with three square-wave tone channels and one noise channel, each with a 4-bit attenuator, written a byte at a time through one port.
entries.behaviour: A byte with bit 7 set latches a register and sets its low four bits. A byte with bit 7 clear supplies the high six bits of a latched tone register.
